method: A fresh SQLite database built by applying all 84 current-master migrations in order, seeded with 200,000 audit rows across 12 principals, one in seven carrying an admin action. Each query is the shape the admin audit page issues. The A leg keeps the merged read-order indexes; the B leg drops exactly the five indexes that migration 0088 adds, on a fresh connection so the planner re-plans.
